abstract.p: We introduce TR-MTEB, the first large-scale, task-diverse benchmark designed to evaluate sentence embedding models for Turkish. Covering six core tasks as classification, clustering, pair classification, retrieval, bitext mining, and semantic textual similarity, TR-MTEB incorporates 26 high-quality datasets, including native and translated resources. To complement this benchmark, we construct a corpus of 34.2 million weakly supervised Turkish sentence pairs and train two Turkish-specific embedding models using contrastive pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. Evaluation results show that our models, despite being trained on limited resources, achieve competitive performance across most tasks and significantly improve upon baseline monolingual models. All datasets, models, and evaluation pipelines are publicly released 1 to facilitate further research in Turkish natural language processing and low-resource benchmarking.
